protocol: PROTOCOL.md section 11, M5 (edit detection on SYNTHETIC cuts)
note: Every cut is SYNTHETIC: a stretch removed from the 60-min excerpt audio with gunj.synthetic.cut_audio at harvest time. Positions are seconds into the excerpt, which starts 120 s into the recording.

method.locate_call: calibrate_latency.run_search (weighted v2 matcher, +-1 day around the release time in IST), top candidate
method.find_edits_call: gunj.match.find_edits(trace, reference, validity mask, lock) with no keyword
method.detection: an edit of kind "cut" with |clip_time_s - true position| <= 30 s; the nearest one
method.duration_error: |jump_s of the detecting edit - true cut length|, detected cuts only
method.false_alarm: any edit reported on the uncut 60-min excerpt of the same streams
method.per_cut_description_fields: either_kind_within_window, other_edits and lock_minus_uncut_lock_s describe a cut trace and are not part of the metric; their totals are under "exploratory" (EXPLORATORY, post hoc)

preregistered.label: PRE-REGISTERED: PROTOCOL.md section 11, M5. Every cut is SYNTHETIC.
preregistered.stream_rule: Test streams whose uncut 60-min excerpt is a confident hit in the full scope (extractor v2; results table)

exploratory.label: EXPLORATORY (post hoc). Nothing under this key is in PROTOCOL.md, and none of it is part of the pre-registered M5 result. Every cut is SYNTHETIC.

gate_locks.label: EXPLORATORY (post hoc): every gate lock (extractor v2, any excerpt length, full or +-90-day scope) that has SYNTHETIC cut traces. Includes the pre-registered streams.

additional_streams_only.label: EXPLORATORY (post hoc): gate locks that are not in the pre-registered M5 set
